title: Which word fits the blank? | 책 Korean quiz
description:
MalmoeLab Korean fill-in-the-blank short for English learners.

Question: ___을 읽고 메모를 합니다.
Answer: 책 (chaek)
Meaning: book
Example: 책을 읽고 메모를 합니다.
English: I read a book and take notes.
